info.title: SwipeRx Operator
info.description:
Ninja Van Indonesia's delivery-compliance and returns tool for the SwipeRx pharmaceutical account. Implant/DE staff turn a SwipeRx TMP batch file into a Ninja Van order-creation upload with a tokenized courier link per AWB; couriers open that link at the pharmacy to capture the required POD/RDO photos and flag rejected goods; ops then acknowledge each reject and record the replacement return TIDs.

Staff endpoints are authenticated by the Substrait SSO gateway (X-Forwarded-Email) and authorized by role. The /api/c/{token} courier endpoints are deliberately unauthenticated: the link token is itself the credential, because riders open them from a delivery instruction on a phone with no account.

tags.name: oc
tags.description: Order-creation intake: parse a TMP batch, commit AWBs, download the NV upload.

tags.name: returns
tags.description: Reject-return pipeline through to RTS and return TIDs.

tags.name: manual
tags.description: Ad-hoc courier links outside a TMP batch.

tags.name: courier
tags.description: Unauthenticated rider capture wizard; the link token is the credential.

get.summary: Unauthenticated readiness probe that always returns the literal object {"status": "ok"} without touching the database.

200.description: Service is up.

get.summary: Returns the configured app name and environment, the full app_version changelog newest-first (empty when no DB pool is initialised), and which sign-in mechanisms apply to this particular request.

parameters.name: x-forwarded-email
parameters.description: Injected by the Substrait platform SSO gateway. Its presence sets auth.sso_proxy to true and forces auth.dev_login to false.

200.description: Version, changelog and per-request auth capabilities.

get.summary: Streams the raw bytes of a stored blob looked up by its opaque storage key, replaying the content type recorded when it was uploaded.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Opaque storage ref (a UUID4 string as generated by BlobStorage.put; persisted in the *_ref columns).

parameters.name: swiperx_session
parameters.description: Local-dev JWT session cookie. Only consulted when the request did not arrive through the SSO gateway.

200.description: The blob body. The response Content-Type is whatever was stored alongside the bytes (image/jpeg, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, etc.), so it is not fixed by this spec.

401.description: No SSO header and no valid session cookie (detail: not_authenticated or invalid_session).

404.description: No media_blob row for this key. Returned as a bare empty response with no body.

get.summary: Retired stub for the removed in-app Google OIDC flow; it performs no authentication and unconditionally redirects the caller to the app root.

307.description: Temporary redirect to "/" (Starlette RedirectResponse default status). No response body.

post.summary: Local-development stopgap that mints a JWT session cookie for any registered, active email address without a password, refusing outright unless DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED is on and the request did not come through the SSO gateway.

parameters.name: x-forwarded-email
parameters.description: If present at all, the endpoint hard-fails with 404 regardless of DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED.

200.description: Session minted. Sets the swiperx_session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, path=/, max-age SESSION_TTL_SECONDS, Secure when PUBLIC_BASE_URL is https).

403.description: Address is not registered or has been deactivated (detail: unknown_or_inactive).

404.description: Dev login is switched off, or the request carried the SSO proxy header (detail: disabled).

422.description: Request validation error (missing or non-string email).

get.summary: Resolves the caller's identity from the SSO header (falling back to the dev session cookie) and reports their database-backed roles plus a has_access flag that is false for an authenticated address no superadmin has registered yet.

parameters.name: x-forwarded-email
parameters.description: Primary identity source, injected by the platform gateway.

parameters.name: swiperx_session
parameters.description: Local-dev JWT fallback, used only when the SSO header is absent.

200.description: Current identity and roles. id is 0 and roles is empty for a gateway-authenticated address with no users row.

401.description: No SSO header and no valid session cookie (detail: not_authenticated or invalid_session).

post.summary: Deletes the local swiperx_session cookie; the platform SSO session itself is unaffected and must be ended from the Substrait side.

200.description: Cookie cleared.

get.summary: Superadmin-only listing of every registered account ordered by id, with each account's roles fetched from user_roles and the TINYINT active column coerced to a boolean.

200.description: All registered users.

401.description: Caller has no identity (detail: not_authenticated or invalid_session).

403.description: Caller is authenticated but does not hold the superadmin role (detail: forbidden).

post.summary: Superadmin-only registration of a new active account by lower-cased Google email, rejecting the request unless at least one submitted role is in the ALL_ROLES allowlist and no user already holds that address.

201.description: User created. email is the normalised (stripped, lower-cased) address; roles is the de-duplicated, allowlist-filtered set actually inserted.

id.description: lastrowid of the users INSERT (0 if the driver reported none).

400.description: None of the submitted roles is a known role (detail: no_valid_role).

401.description: Caller has no identity (detail: not_authenticated or invalid_session).

403.description: Caller is not a superadmin (detail: forbidden).

409.description: A users row already exists for this google_email (detail: already_registered).

patch.summary: Superadmin-only partial update that replaces an existing user's whole role set (delete-then-reinsert) and/or flips their active flag, applying only the fields actually supplied.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: users.id of the account to update.

200.description: Updated user id and its roles re-read from user_roles after the write.

400.description: roles was supplied but contained no known role (detail: no_valid_role).

401.description: Caller has no identity (detail: not_authenticated or invalid_session).

403.description: Caller is not a superadmin (detail: forbidden).

404.description: No users row with this id (detail: not_found).

get.summary: Returns the enabled OC service definitions (code, movement, service level, direction, branch and shipper identity) together with the warehouse origins, so the intake form can populate its service and origin pickers.

200.description: Service and origin catalogue read from oc_config.json.

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role (detail: "forbidden").

post.summary: Parses an uploaded SwipeRx TMP workbook against the chosen service and returns the grouped AWBs, piece totals and per-row errors without writing anything to the database.

service.description: Service code; must match the `code` of an enabled service (e.g. S1, S2, S3).

200.description: Parse result: what would be committed, plus the rows that failed.

400.description: detail is "unknown_service" (code not in the enabled service list) or "empty_file" (zero-byte upload).

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

422.description: The workbook is unusable as a whole (OcError) — unreadable xlsx or a header-cell check that identifies it as the wrong TMP for the chosen service. detail is the engine's free-text message.

post.summary: Commits a parsed TMP batch: stores the source file, inserts one AWB row per group with an unguessable courier token and generated delivery instructions, inserts its PO lines, then builds and stores the Ninja Van upload .xlsx and the links .csv and returns the courier links plus download URLs.

service.description: Service code; must match the `code` of an enabled service (e.g. S1, S2, S3).

delivery_date.description: Single ISO yyyy-mm-dd delivery day written into col S of the upload. Omitted or empty means today.

origin.description: Origin warehouse code; must be a key of the configured origins (see GET /api/oc/services).

201.description: Intake created; AWBs, tokens, upload.xlsx and links.csv persisted.

400.description: detail is "bad_delivery_date" (not ISO yyyy-mm-dd), "bad_origin" (missing or not a configured origin), "unknown_service", or "empty_file".

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

409.description: detail is "all_awbs_already_exist" — every AWB in the file was already in the database, so nothing was committed; the intake row is left with status 'no_new_awbs' and awb/row counts of 0.

422.description: detail is the engine's OcError message (unreadable/wrong workbook) or "no_valid_awbs" when the parse yielded no AWB groups at all.

get.summary: Lists the 100 most recent order intakes, newest id first, with their service code, AWB/piece/row counts, status and stringified upload timestamp.

200.description: Recent intakes.

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

get.summary: Returns one intake's header row (including its error summary) alongside every AWB created from it, each with its courier URL rebuilt from the stored link token.

200.description: Intake header plus its AWBs.

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

delete.summary: Deletes an intake together with all of its AWBs and their PO lines so the SwipeAWBs are free for a corrected re-upload, refusing outright if any AWB has courier activity (a driver submission, a status past 'created', a document capture, or a return parcel); the generated file blobs are intentionally left in storage.

204.description: Intake, AWBs and PO lines deleted; an oc_intake_delete audit_log entry is written. No response body.

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

409.description: detail is "intake_has_courier_activity" — at least one AWB in the batch has been submitted by a driver, moved past status 'created', has a document_capture row, or has a return_parcel referencing it. Nothing is deleted.

get.summary: Returns every courier link ever created, newest first, optionally filtered by a substring matched against AWB id, pharmacy name or city, so an operator can find and copy a link on screen instead of downloading the CSV.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed and wrapped in % wildcards, then LIKE-matched against awb_id, pharmacy_name and city.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Row cap; clamped server-side into the range 1..2000.

200.description: Matching courier links and the number returned.

count.description: Length of `links` (rows returned after the clamped limit), not a total match count.

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

get.summary: Streams back the stored Ninja Van upload workbook generated for this intake, as an attachment named <Service>-upload_<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>.xlsx (falling back to the intake id if the row cannot be read).

200.description: The generated OC upload workbook. Sent with Content-Disposition: attachment.

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

404.description: detail is "not_found" (no such intake, or it has no oc_template_ref) or "file_missing" (the referenced blob is absent from media storage).

get.summary: Streams back the stored courier-links CSV generated for this intake, as an attachment named <Service>-links_<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>.csv (falling back to the intake id if the row cannot be read).

200.description: The generated links CSV. Sent with Content-Disposition: attachment.

403.description: Caller does not hold the implant, de or superadmin role.

404.description: detail is "not_found" (no such intake, or it has no links_file_ref) or "file_missing" (the referenced blob is absent from media storage).

get.summary: Unauthenticated entry point for a printed courier link: verifies the token matches an AWB and 307-redirects the rider to the SPA wizard route /c/{token}, keeping links printed under the old /api/c path working.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The per-AWB link token (awb.link_token), a URL-safe secret of 24 random bytes.

307.description: Token resolved; temporary redirect to the frontend wizard route /c/{token}. No response body.

get.summary: Returns up to 500 reject-return rows newest-first with their derived stage, closing pipeline, origin-unknown flag and at-the-door proof photos, optionally filtered to one derived stage.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Filter on the DERIVED stage. Rejected with 400 bad_stage if not one of the listed values.

200.description: The worklist plus the RTS shipper account the deck mandates.

403.description: forbidden — requires implant, de, station_ic or program_manager (superadmin always passes)

post.summary: Stamps the given origin warehouse onto only those selected return rows that currently have no origin, never overwriting one already recorded, and writes a return_origin_bulk_set audit entry.

ids.description: return_parcel.id values; empty list is rejected with 400 no_ids.

origin.description: Must be a key of oc_engine.CFG['origins'].

200.description: How many rows were actually changed, and the origin applied.

403.description: forbidden — implant, de, station_ic, program_manager

get.summary: Builds and downloads the Ninja return-OC CSV covering every partial (sebagian) reject still at pending_de_upload whose origin is known, excluding origin-unknown rows so nothing ships to the wrong city.

200.description: CSV produced by oc_engine.build_return_csv; Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="Return-OC-pending.csv".

403.description: forbidden — requires implant or de

post.summary: Records that DE pushed the exported return OC into Ninja: stamps de_uploaded_at/by and the generated <SwipeAWB>-R01 return tracking number on each selected partial reject still at pending_de_upload, moving it to Pending Print.

200.description: Count of rows moved to pending_print.

403.description: forbidden — requires implant or de

409.description: origin_unknown — a selected row has no origin, so it must not be uploaded yet

post.summary: Closes each selected row sitting at pending_print by stamping printed_at/printed_by, recording that Station IC printed the label and repacked the parcel.

200.description: Count of rows marked printed.

403.description: forbidden — requires station_ic, implant or de

post.summary: Stamps rts_requested_at/by on each selected full refusal (semua) still at pending_de_upload, closing it on its original forward tracking number without minting any new AWB.

200.description: Count of rows moved to rts_triggered.

403.description: forbidden — requires implant or de

get.summary: Downloads the BOM-prefixed RTS list of every full refusal at pending_de_upload or rts_triggered, with a rts_marked yes/no column so the file matches what was just bulk-marked.

200.description: UTF-8 BOM + CSV, columns: forward_tracking_id, pharmacy, hub, reject_pcs, rejected_at, rts_marked.

403.description: forbidden — requires implant or de

get.summary: Downloads the whole worklist flattened to one audit CSV row per return, carrying every stage timestamp and the email of whoever stamped it, including the legacy validator and pasted-TID columns.

200.description: UTF-8 BOM + CSV, columns: return_id, forward_awb, return_awb, pharmacy, city, reject_type, rejected_at, stage, closes_by, hub, origin, reject_pcs, legacy_validated_at, legacy_validated_by, de_uploaded_at, de_uploaded_by, printed_at, printed_by, rts_requested_at, rts_requested_by, legacy_return_tids.

403.description: forbidden — implant, de, station_ic, program_manager

post.summary: Creates one hand-typed test AWB (with its PO lines) in the real awb/po_line tables, mints an unguessable link token, and returns the courier URL together with the ready-to-paste col-R delivery-instructions string and the Ninja upload column values.

201.description: Everything needed to paste the link into Ninja by hand.

400.description: awb_id_required, awb_id_too_long, unknown_service, bad_children_mode, bad_delivery_date, collies_must_be_positive or collies_above_cap

403.description: forbidden — requires superadmin, implant or de

get.summary: Lists up to 200 newest test AWBs — those with intake_id IS NULL, i.e. created outside any TMP intake — replacing each stored link_token with its full courier URL.

200.description: Manual test links and how many were returned.

403.description: forbidden — requires superadmin, implant or de

get.summary: Rebuilds this manual AWB and its PO lines from the database and streams back a one-row Ninja upload workbook so the tester can upload rather than retype it.

parameters.name: awb_id
parameters.description: Only matches rows with intake_id IS NULL.

200.description: XLSX workbook from oc_engine.build_upload_xlsx.

403.description: forbidden — requires superadmin, implant or de

404.description: not_found — no manual AWB with that id

delete.summary: Deletes a test AWB and its PO lines so the same identifier can be retried, scoped to intake_id IS NULL so a real TMP-intake AWB can never be removed, and logs manual_link_delete.

403.description: forbidden — requires superadmin, implant or de

404.description: not_found — no manual AWB with that id

get.summary: Resolves the link token to its single AWB and returns everything the courier app renders — address, PO lines, photos already captured, remembered driver/hub, the active hub list, the locked fail-reason list, and whether the link is expired or already terminal (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: awb.link_token — the sole credential for this route.

200.description: The courier order view.

post.summary: Records the driver ID (numeric-only, max 32 chars) and hub on the AWB before any capture, validating the hub against the active hub master unless the driver ticked "not listed", in which case it is stored uppercased (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

driver_id.description: Digits only after stripping; max 32 chars.

hub_name.description: 2-32 chars. Must exist in hub with active = 1 unless hub_not_listed is true.

hub_not_listed.description: True skips the hub-master check and uppercases the typed value.

200.description: The values as stored (hub_name may be uppercased).

409.description: already_submitted — AWB is in a terminal status

get.summary: Streams a stored photo only after confirming the blob ref belongs to this token's AWB via document_capture or failed_delivery, so a token can never read another order's media (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: media_blob id (uuid4) held in document_capture.photo_ref or failed_delivery.proof_photo_ref.

200.description: The image bytes, served with the content type recorded at upload time.

404.description: invalid_link, not_found (ref not owned by this AWB) or file_missing (blob gone)

post.summary: Stores one uploaded photo against the AWB after validating doc type, size (12 MB cap) and image content type, replacing any prior shot of a single-shot doc type (or same-PO sp_manual), and stamping driver_submitted_at on first capture (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

doc_type.description: Form field. sp_manual additionally requires po_number.

file.description: UploadFile. Non-empty, <= 12582912 bytes, content type must be image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/heic or image/heif.

timestamp_source.description: Form field. Echoed back in the response but not persisted on document_capture.

po_number.description: Form field. When supplied it must match a po_line row on this AWB.

signed_stamped.description: Form field. Stored as 0/1, or NULL when omitted.

400.description: unknown_doc_type, bad_timestamp_source, empty_file, sp_manual_needs_po or unknown_po

patch.summary: Sets or clears the signed+stamped attestation flag on one already-captured document belonging to this token's AWB (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

200.description: The capture id and its new attestation value.

404.description: invalid_link, or not_found when the capture is not on this AWB

delete.summary: Deletes one capture row on this token's AWB so the courier can retake the photo, leaving the underlying blob in media_blob (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

404.description: invalid_link, or not_found when the capture is not on this AWB

get.summary: Recomputes the server-side completeness gate for the given outcome and returns the human-readable Indonesian labels of whatever photos or attestations are still missing, so the app can disable its confirm button (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

200.description: Gate state for that outcome.

post.summary: Re-checks the completeness gate then closes the delivery — sets the AWB to delivered with its return_type, records the submitting IP, and on a reject opens the ops reject-return worklist row (once per AWB) inheriting the forward order's origin (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

return_type.description: Only read when outcome is reject; anything other than sebagian/semua falls back to sebagian.

reject_pcs.description: Pieces coming back. Required (> 0) on a reject unless the AWB is itself a return service.

200.description: Always status 'delivered'; return_awbs carries the forward AWB id on a reject and is empty otherwise.

422.description: Gate failed — detail is {"error": "incomplete", "missing": [...]}; or detail is the string "reject_pcs_required".

post.summary: Records a failed delivery against one of the nine locked reason codes, reusing the most recent capture on the AWB as the proof photo, setting the AWB to delivery_failed with the submitting IP, and opening no return track (UNAUTHENTICATED: the token is the only credential).

200.description: Constant shape: status 'delivery_failed', return_flagged false, return_awbs empty.

422.description: No capture exists to use as proof — detail is {"error": "incomplete", "missing": ["Foto bukti"]}.

Role.description: A role from config.ALL_ROLES. Values outside this set are silently dropped by users._clean_roles.

User.description: A row of the users table joined with its user_roles. Shape returned by GET /api/users.

active.description: users.active TINYINT(1), coerced to bool by the handler.

MeResponse.description: Identity envelope built by auth.me from the security.current_user dict.

id.description: users.id, or 0 for a gateway-authenticated address with no users row.

email.description: users.google_email under SSO; the JWT 'email' claim on the dev-cookie path, which may be null.

name.description: users.name under SSO (falls back to the email itself when unregistered); the JWT 'name' claim on the dev-cookie path, which may be null.

has_access.description: bool(roles) — false means show the contact-admin screen.

ChangelogEntry.description: One app_version row as returned by GET /api/version. The id column is not selected.

released_at.description: DATETIME stringified with str(), so 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' rather than RFC 3339.

changelog.description: app_version rows ordered by released_at DESC, id DESC. Empty when the DB pool is not initialised.

sso_proxy.description: True when this request carried the x-forwarded-email header.

dev_login.description: DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED AND no proxy header on this request.

DevLoginRequest.description: Not a Pydantic model in the source: auth.dev_login declares email: str = Body(..., embed=True), which produces this single-key object.

email.description: Address to impersonate; matched case-insensitively against users.google_email and must be active.

RegisterUserRequest.description: Not a Pydantic model in the source: users.register_user declares three separate Body(...) params, which FastAPI merges into this object.

email.description: Stored stripped and lower-cased in users.google_email.

roles.description: Filtered against ALL_ROLES and de-duplicated; must yield at least one valid role or the request is rejected with 400 no_valid_role. The default of [] therefore always fails validation in practice.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Not a Pydantic model in the source: users.update_user declares two optional Body(...) params. Both default to null and a null field is left untouched; an empty body is a valid no-op.

roles.description: When supplied, replaces the entire role set (existing user_roles rows are deleted first). Filtered against ALL_ROLES; an all-invalid list yields 400 no_valid_role.

active.description: When supplied, written to users.active as 1 or 0.

HTTPError.description: FastAPI's HTTPException body. 'detail' is a short machine-readable slug (e.g. not_authenticated, forbidden, not_found, bad_stage) or, on 422 from the OC engine, a free-text parse message.

Service.description: One enabled OC service from oc_config.json (disabled services are omitted entirely). All identifiers are strings in config.

direction.description: "forward" or "return"; selects which parser the engine uses.

branch_id.description: Corporate branch id selecting the per-service shipper.

master_shipper_id.description: Global master shipper id (col B of the upload); identical on every service.

Origin.description: A SwipeRx warehouse a batch can ship out of; stored on the intake and on every AWB so a later return can address itself home.

code.description: Origin key; the value accepted by the `origin` form field on POST /api/oc/create.

ParseError.description: One row- or AWB-level problem found while parsing the TMP file. Produced by the engine, plus create-time entries for AWBs skipped because they already exist.

row.description: 1-based worksheet row, or null for AWB-level problems (no valid collies, collie cap exceeded, already exists).

awb.description: SwipeAWB the problem belongs to; empty string for an orphan row seen before any SwipeAWB.

AwbPreview.description: One parsed AWB group as shown before committing. Built by oc.py::_awb_preview.

collies.description: Summed koli across the AWB's PO lines.

po_count.description: Number of PO lines grouped under this AWB.

pieces.description: Number of MPS child piece TRIDs the AWB will generate.

service.description: Echo of the submitted service code.

piece_count.description: Total child piece TRIDs across all parsed AWBs.

CreatedLink.description: One committed AWB and its courier link, as returned by POST /api/oc/create.

koli.description: Total collies for the AWB (the engine's `collies` value).

url.description: {COURIER_BASE_URL}/c/{token} — the link injected into the delivery instructions.

intake_id.description: New order_intake.id (insert id returned by db.execute).

piece_count.description: Child piece TRIDs across committed AWBs only.

error_count.description: Parse errors plus AWBs skipped as already existing.

warning.description: Pipe-joined advisories about a file that is valid but not what the operator would assume — RDO instruction text truncated to the 500-char col R cap, and/or AWBs whose height/length/width columns ship blank. Each names up to 5 example AWBs. Null when there is nothing to warn about.

IntakeSummary.description: One row of GET /api/oc/intakes, straight from order_intake.

uploaded_at.description: DATETIME stringified with str(); not guaranteed RFC 3339.

IntakeDetail.description: The `intake` object of GET /api/oc/intakes/{intake_id} — IntakeSummary plus error_summary.

error_summary.description: "; "-joined "<awb or row N>: <error>" lines recorded at create time; null when there were none.

IntakeAwb.description: One AWB under an intake. link_token is popped from the row and never returned; courier_url is derived from it.

is_return.description: TINYINT coerced to bool by the handler.

CourierLinkRow.description: One row of GET /api/oc/links. Like IntakeAwb but adds service/intake provenance and created_at; link_token is likewise replaced by courier_url.

is_return.description: TINYINT coerced to bool by the handler.

service_id.description: The service code stored on the AWB at create time.

IncompleteError.description: 422 body when the courier completeness gate fails.

missing.description: Indonesian UI labels of the missing requirements.

BulkUpdateResult.description: Shared response of the three bulk stage-advance endpoints (mark-uploaded, mark-printed, rts).

updated.description: Rows actually changed — selected ids not in the eligible stage are silently skipped.

ProofPhoto.description: At-the-door evidence attached to a return row (doc types rejected_goods, delivery_note, awb_sticker).

ReturnRow.description: One reject-return worklist row: return_parcel joined to its forward awb and to users for the actor emails, then shaped by _shape(). All timestamps are stringified with str(datetime) ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'), not ISO-8601 'T' format, and are null when unset.

return_type.description: Column default is 'sebagian'; 'semua' means a full refusal.

return_awb_id.description: The <SwipeAWB>-R01 number, stamped only at mark-uploaded for partials.

reject_pcs.description: Pieces the driver counted back at the door.

validated_at.description: Legacy validator stamp; no longer gates anything.

hub_name.description: From the forward awb, set by the driver at identity.

stage.description: Derived from the timestamps above, never stored.

origin_unknown.description: True when no origin is recorded; blocks export and mark-uploaded.

proof_photos.description: Only populated by GET /api/returns; absent from the internal row shape used by the write endpoints.

PoLine.description: A purchase-order line on an AWB, as selected from po_line.

koli.description: Collie count for this PO, not units.

PoLineInput.description: Untyped dict accepted by the manual link builder; unknown keys are ignored, lines with a blank po_number are dropped, and a non-integer koli falls back to 1.

Capture.description: A stored document photo as returned inside the courier order view (_captures()).

CaptureCreated.description: Response of POST /api/c/{token}/capture. Note captured_at here is ISO-8601 (datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')), unlike the space-separated form in Capture, and timestamp_source is echoed back but not persisted.

id.description: document_capture lastrowid; 0 if the driver returned none.

FailReason.description: One entry of the locked PRD 7.2.1 fail-reason list, in render order.

CourierOrder.description: Everything the tokenized courier app renders for one AWB.

hubs.description: hub_name of every active hub, alphabetical.

terminal.description: status is delivered, arrived, handed_over or delivery_failed.

missing.description: Indonesian labels of what is still required; empty when complete.

return_awbs.description: The forward awb_id when a reject was recorded (no new tracking number is minted here); otherwise empty.

ManualLinkCreate.description: Body of POST /api/manual/links. FastAPI embeds all of these as top-level JSON keys.

service.description: Must be the code of an ENABLED service from oc_engine.services(); S3 is currently disabled in oc_config.json.

weight.description: Kept as text to preserve source formatting; empty falls back to '1'.

collies.description: Explicit collie total wins over the sum of po_lines koli; must be >= 1 and <= max_collies_per_awb (200).

children_mode.description: 'blank' leaves col AC empty to test whether NV auto-creates children.

delivery_date.description: ISO date; defaults to today. Validated but not persisted on the awb row.

delivery_instructions.description: The col-R string to paste verbatim.

instr_truncated.description: True when the text had to be ellipsis-trimmed to fit.

upload_columns.description: Ninja upload values named by spreadsheet column.

AC_piece_tracking_numbers.description: Child TRIDs joined with ', '; empty when children_mode is 'blank'.

children.description: Child piece TRIDs; empty list when children_mode is 'blank'.

ManualLinkSummary.description: One row of GET /api/manual/links. link_token is popped from the row and replaced by courier_url.
